title: Book 2 — Euterpe, Chapter 298
paragraphs: Their divination is ordered thus: the art is assigned not to any man, but to certain of the gods; for there are in their land Oracles of Heracles, of Apollo, of Athene, of Artemis, of Ares, and of Zeus, and moreover that which they hold in highest honour of all — namely the Oracle of Leto which is in the city of Buto. The manner of divination, however, is not everywhere established in the same fashion, but differs in different places.
